name: Open WebUI MCP Server
description: Exposes Open WebUI's admin APIs as tools, allowing AI assistants to manage users, groups, models, knowledge bases, and chats. It enables comprehensive administrative control and resource discovery while respecting the platform's native permission and authentication systems.
